definitions.FAIL: at least one executed gate failed
definitions.INCOMPLETE: one or more required software gates did not run
definitions.PHYSICAL_ACCEPTANCE_PASS: software, real-model, and distinct physical-machine gates passed
definitions.REAL_MODEL_ACCEPTANCE_PASS: all software and four architecture-neutral real-model gates passed
definitions.SOFTWARE_ACCEPTANCE_PASS: all software gates passed; real-model and physical closure are not claimed
